## Summary

Describe what changed and why.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run lint`
- [ ] `npm run security:all`
- [ ] `npm run test:coverage`
- [ ] `npm run coverage:check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run bootstrap:verify`
- [ ] `npm run e2e`

## Review checklist

- [ ] No application-specific behavior leaked into the reusable template unintentionally.
- [ ] Architecture/security boundaries remain explicit.
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation was updated when commands, behavior, compatibility, or policy changed.
- [ ] Dependency/budget/coverage changes are intentional and justified.
